title: Calendar cycle: project calendar reference, deletion boundary and persisted parity
evidenceCommitNote: This file is stored by the evidence commit that follows testedCodeSha.

domain_rules.PROJECT_CALENDAR_NOT_FOUND: project settings require a calendar id and version stored in the same scope
domain_rules.PROJECT_CALENDAR_KIND_MISMATCH: DATE_BASED needs working-day and TIME_AWARE needs working-time, matching the stored master kind
domain_rules.deleted_calendar: publication after deletion fails closed with CALENDAR_VERSION_NOT_FOUND; it never rebinds to another stored version

scenarios: settings save rejects a missing calendar id with PROJECT_CALENDAR_NOT_FOUND and leaves no settings row
settings save rejects a known id with an unknown version
settings save rejects a TIME_AWARE project bound to a working-day calendar
deleting a stored project calendar makes the next publication fail closed instead of rebinding
the schedule cycle lists stored calendars with name/id/version/kind and persists the selected reference across reload (browser evidence)
limitations: Calendar deletion is still allowed for an unreferenced calendar; a referenced calendar is not blocked at delete time in this stage, but the persisted reference can no longer be resolved and scheduling/publication fails closed with a stable code.
Timezone conversion stays in the schedule core; the UI does not convert dates on its own.
